subject: Acme procurement + security qualification / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme procurement + security qualification / next steps

Hi Jamie / Priya  thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Use case & timeline: Proof-of-concept for retrieval-augmented generation across customer support (pilot target: 3 teams, start of July).
- Commercial path: Jamie indicated procurement prefers a PO-based purchase for initial contract but open to card for POC. Please confirm who will issue the PO and approximate lead time.
- Marketplace: You mentioned evaluating via your internal cloud marketplace. Happy to discuss pros/cons; marketplace purchases can simplify invoicing but have different SLAs.
- Security/compliance gating: You asked about SOC 2 and DPA. We have the SOC 2 Type II report (2026) and a standard DPA; I'll attach the DPA draft and the SOC2 stub and loop in legal for any redlines.
- Next steps: 1) Jamie to confirm procurement path (PO vs card) and procurement contact; 2) Acme to return security questionnaire (attached) if helpful; 3) Redwood to share DPA and SOC 2 artifacts and provide mutual action plan.

Attachments: acme_security_questionnaire.xlsx (your form), Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf.

If helpful I can send a short MAP (mutual action plan) with dates. Thanks  I'll follow up with legal on the DPA/SOC2 items.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement + security qualification / next steps

Thanks Marissa  great recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement path: Our default is PO for any contracted spend > $10k/month. For an initial POC (pilot) we often approve a P-card purchase to speed things up, but the team will need to confirm. I expect procurement to push for PO if this becomes a multi-team pilot.
- Timeline: We are targeting internal approval by end of June if the pilot scoping and security review look good.
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 Type II and a draft DPA would be perfect. We'll also fill out the questionnaire (attached) and send it back.
- Marketplace: We are evaluating marketplace options  if Redwood is available through our cloud marketplace that could simplify contracting and invoicing. Would that be possible?

Action items for us: I'll loop in our procurement lead (I'll forward their contact once I have it) and Priya will start the security questionnaire.

One question for legal: are there any data residency or logging controls required by the DPA by default, or are those negotiable?

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Collins
Head of Partner Integrations, Acme, Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acme.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement + security qualification / next steps

Thanks Jamie  looping in Dev (legal) to confirm the DPA/ SOC2 details. Dev  attaching Acme's questionnaire that Priya mentioned and our standard DPA + SOC2 stub. Can you confirm: 

1) Is the standard DPA sufficient for a PO-based purchase or will Acme need DPA redlines?
2) SOC2: we can share the full report under an NDA / secure link. Is that acceptable or do you need anything else (bridge letters, SOC2 controls mapping)?
3) Marketplace: do we have a standard offer through AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace that would allow PO via marketplace purchase? If so, are there any changes to billing or SLAs we should call out for Acme?

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf, acme_security_questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks  appreciate a quick read so we can keep Acme on the June timeline.

 Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement + security qualification / next steps

Hi all  quick responses below and next steps from legal/security: 

1) DPA: Our standard DPA is compatible with PO-based purchases. We are OK with Acme redlining the DPA; small commercial teams typically accept our standard with limited redlines. If Acme has a few specific clauses (data residency, subprocessor disclosures, audit window) list them and we'll respond.

2) SOC 2: We can share the SOC 2 Type II report (2026) via secure link or under NDA. We also have a controls mapping doc that explains how our controls map to common questionnaires  that often speeds review.

3) Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace with a meter-based offering and on GCP marketplace as a subscription in selected regions. Marketplace purchases can be routed differently (resellers / marketplace billing) which sometimes affects invoicing and SLAs; if Acme prefers marketplace we'll coordinate with our channel ops to confirm whether PO flow will be supported for this deal. For procurement simplicity, P-card for initial POC -> PO for pilot scale is a reasonable path.

Next steps from our side: 
- I'll upload the SOC2 report and controls mapping to a secure share and send the link (or we can NDAs as needed).
- Marissa: I suggest we propose a short MAP with milestones (PO decision, security signoff, pilot start) and include the procurement contact once Jamie shares it.

Best,
Dev Patel
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acme.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement + security qualification / next steps

Great  thanks Dev and Jamie. Jamie: once you have the procurement contact I'll send an initial MAP and a short summary invoice options doc (PO vs card vs marketplace).

Proposed MAP (short):
- May 23-28: Acme completes security questionnaire and confirms procurement path
- May 29-June 3: Redwood sends secure SOC2 link and final DPA; Acme legal reviews/returns redlines
- June 6-17: Procurement approval & PO issuance (if PO path chosen)
- July 1: Pilot kickoff

If that timeline looks reasonable I'll send the MAP and add dates once I have your procurement contact.

Thanks  looking forward to moving this forward.

Marissa
